sections.label: ICMD sectors as growth multipliers
sections.summary: MCI will strengthen the Infocomm, Media and Design sectors by implementing the Infocomm Media Industry Transformation Map and deepening digital technology capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: To that end, MCI will strengthen the Infocomm, Media and Design (ICMD) sectors as growth multipliers for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will implement the Infocomm Media Industry Transformation Map and deepen our capabilities in digital technologies to grow the sector and create exciting new jobs.

sections.label: Digital transformation and SME support
sections.summary: A stronger ICMD sector will accelerate digital transformation, with the SMEs Go Digital programme expanded and TeSA ramped up to equip Singaporeans with skills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: A stronger ICMD sector will enable Singapore to accelerate digital transformation across the economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will expand our small and medium enterprises (SMEs) Go Digital programme to help our SMEs ride this new wave of growth, and develop more targeted Industry Digital Plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will prepare Singaporeans for a more vibrant, innovation-driven digital economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will ramp up the TechSkills Accelerator (TeSA) efforts to equip more Singaporeans with relevant skills.

sections.label: Regulations and Digital Readiness Blueprint
sections.summary: Regulations including the Broadcasting Act and Personal Data Protection Act will remain fit for purpose, and a Digital Readiness Blueprint will be introduced.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will ensure our regulations remain fit for purpose, including the Broadcasting Act and the Personal Data Protection Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will introduce a Digital Readiness Blueprint to enable all Singaporeans to fully participate in and benefit from digital opportunities in their everyday lives.

sections.label: Singapore Bicentennial history and events
sections.summary: The Bicentennial will go back 500 years to the 14th century, and the Singapore Bicentennial Office will work with partners to organise events.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Beyond looking at the 200 years from 1819, the Bicentennial will go back a further 500 years to the 14th century to appreciate the context of Singapore’s evolution leading up to 1819.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: It is an opportunity to reflect on our rich history, appreciate our transformation into a global city, and reaffirm the values that will take us forward as a sovereign nation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Singapore Bicentennial Office will work with community and corporate partners to organise events that bring Singaporeans along this shared journey.
